_note: Variants are emitted into annual_health_checkup_employee | _employee_spouse | _spouse_only based on tags (employee_only, with_spouse, spouse_only) or variant.ahcPartition.

template.goal: Complete an Annual Health Checkup booking flow
template.constraints: Use testdata values. Appointment date must be at least 5 days from today. Use plausible Indian names, cities, phone numbers.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

phases.description: Open the conversation and state the intent
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has greeted the user and offered HR services or acknowledged health checkup intent

variants.name: AHC Employee Only happy flow
variants.goal: Successfully book an Annual Health Checkup for the employee only

phases.description: Open the conversation and state health checkup intent
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has greeted the user and offered to book an appointment or acknowledged the AHC intent

phases.description: Select Employee Only booking type
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has presented appointment type options (Employee Only, Employee with Spouse, Only Spouse) or asked for booking type

phases.description: Provide a valid appointment date at least 4 days ahead
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted the appointment date and asked for the mobile number
phases.recoveryHint: If date is rejected as past or too soon, provide a later date (22nd May 2026 or later)

phases.description: Provide a valid 10-digit mobile number
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted the mobile number and asked for the state

phases.description: Provide state and city; handle invalid city if rejected
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has presented clinic selection options for the valid city
phases.recoveryHint: If city is rejected, try another city in the same state

phases.description: Click Select on a clinic card to confirm the booking
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the appointment booking with a confirmation message

variants.name: AHC Employee with Spouse happy flow
variants.goal: Successfully book an Annual Health Checkup for employee and spouse

phases.description: Open the conversation and state health checkup intent
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has greeted the user and offered to book an appointment

phases.description: Select Employee with Spouse booking type and provide spouse details
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted the spouse DOB and asked for the appointment date

phases.description: Provide a valid future appointment date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted the appointment date and asked for mobile number
phases.recoveryHint: Use 22nd May 2026 or a date at least 5 days in the future

phases.description: Provide a valid 10-digit mobile number
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted the mobile number and asked for state

phases.description: Provide state and valid city
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has presented clinic selection for the city

phases.description: Click Select on a clinic card
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the booking for the employee and spouse

variants.name: AHC Only Spouse happy flow
variants.goal: Successfully book an Annual Health Checkup for spouse only

phases.description: Open conversation and state AHC intent
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has greeted and offered to book an appointment

phases.description: Select Only Spouse booking type and provide spouse details
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted valid spouse DOB and asked for appointment date
phases.recoveryHint: If spouse DOB is rejected (under 18), try an older date

phases.description: Provide appointment date and mobile number
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted mobile number and asked for state

phases.description: Provide state and city
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has shown clinic options

phases.description: Click Select on a clinic
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms booking for the spouse

variants.name: AHC reschedule existing booking
variants.goal: Reschedule an existing Annual Health Checkup appointment to a new date
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
Test account must have an existing AHC appointment booked

phases.description: State intent to modify/reschedule the annual health checkup
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has presented Reschedule and Cancel options for the existing booking

phases.description: Choose reschedule and provide new date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted the new date and asked whether to change location

phases.description: Confirm location change and provide new state/city
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has presented clinic options for the new city

phases.description: Click Select on a clinic to confirm reschedule
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the appointment has been rescheduled

variants.name: AHC cancel appointment
variants.goal: Cancel an existing Annual Health Checkup appointment
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
Test account must have an existing AHC appointment booked

phases.description: State intent to modify the annual health checkup
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has presented Reschedule and Cancel options

phases.description: Choose cancel appointment and confirm
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the cancellation of the appointment

variants.name: AHC edge - past date rejected
variants.goal: Verify that the bot rejects past dates and a date that is less than 4 days in advance

phases.description: Start AHC booking flow and reach the date prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for the preferred appointment date

phases.description: Provide a past date, expect rejection with helpful message
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has rejected the past date and asked for a new date

phases.description: Provide a date less than 4 days ahead, expect rejection
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has rejected the near-future date with 4-day advance notice requirement

phases.description: Provide a valid future date and complete the booking
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the appointment booking

variants.name: AHC edge - invalid city rejected
variants.goal: Verify that the bot rejects a city with no facility and accepts a valid city

phases.description: Navigate through booking until the city prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for the city

phases.description: Provide a city with no facility
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has rejected the city and asked to try another location

phases.description: Provide a valid city and complete the booking
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the appointment

variants.name: AHC edge - invalid spouse DOB rejected
variants.goal: Verify that the bot rejects a spouse date of birth that makes them under 18

phases.description: Start booking flow and select Only Spouse or Employee with Spouse
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for the spouse's date of birth

phases.description: Provide a DOB that makes spouse under 18
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has rejected the DOB and asked for a valid one (spouse must be 18+)

phases.description: Provide valid spouse DOB and complete booking
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the appointment booking

variants.name: AHC edge - invalid mobile rejected
variants.goal: Verify that the bot rejects an invalid mobile number and accepts a valid 10-digit number

phases.description: Navigate booking flow until the mobile number prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for a 10-digit mobile number

phases.description: Provide an invalid mobile number (too short)
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has rejected the mobile number and asked for a valid 10-digit number

phases.description: Provide valid mobile and complete the booking
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the appointment

variants.name: AHC edge - 11-digit mobile rejected
variants.goal: Verify that the bot rejects an 11-digit mobile number as invalid

phases.description: Navigate booking flow until the mobile number prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for a 10-digit mobile number

phases.description: Provide an 11-digit mobile number
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has rejected the mobile and asked for a valid 10-digit number

phases.description: Provide valid 10-digit mobile and complete booking
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has confirmed the appointment

variants.name: AHC edge - gibberish input handling
variants.goal: Verify the bot handles nonsense/gibberish input gracefully and recovers to the right step

phases.description: Send gibberish text at the health checkup intent step
phases.completionCriteria: Bot responds gracefully (either asks to clarify or reprompts with options)
phases.recoveryHint: After the gibberish, say 'Annual health checkup' to get back on track

phases.description: Recover and complete a valid AHC booking
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the appointment booking

variants.name: AHC edge - exact 4-day boundary date
variants.goal: Test the exact 4-day advance booking boundary — today+4 should be accepted or borderline

phases.description: Start AHC booking and reach the appointment date prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for preferred appointment date

phases.description: Try the exact 4-day boundary date (today+4)
phases.completionCriteria: Bot either accepts the date and asks for mobile, or rejects it with the 4-day rule message

phases.description: Use a safe date (today+7) to complete the booking
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the appointment

variants.name: AHC edge - weekend date handling
variants.goal: Check if the bot accepts or rejects appointments on weekends (Saturday/Sunday)

phases.description: Navigate to date prompt and try a Saturday or Sunday date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot either accepts the weekend date or explains weekday-only policy
phases.recoveryHint: If weekend is rejected, use a weekday date from testdata

phases.description: Complete the booking with an accepted date
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the appointment

variants.name: AHC edge - state with no facilities
variants.goal: Verify bot handles a state where no health check facility exists

phases.description: Navigate booking until state is asked
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for the state

phases.description: Provide a state with no facilities
phases.completionCriteria: Bot either rejects the state, provides no clinics, or asks to try another location

phases.description: Provide a valid state and complete the booking
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the appointment

variants.name: AHC edge - spouse younger than 18 by 1 day
variants.goal: Verify exact boundary: spouse DOB making them exactly just under 18 years old is rejected

phases.description: Start AHC booking with spouse and reach DOB prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for spouse date of birth

phases.description: Provide a DOB that makes spouse under 18
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects the DOB with under-18 message

phases.description: Provide a valid adult DOB and complete booking
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the appointment

variants.name: AHC edge - alphanumeric input as mobile
variants.goal: Verify the bot rejects letters/symbols entered as a mobile number

phases.description: Navigate to the mobile number prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked for a 10-digit mobile number

phases.description: Send alphabetic text where mobile number is expected
phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects and asks for a valid 10-digit number

phases.description: Provide valid mobile and complete booking
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the appointment
